_comment: Reserved for the final headline numbers only: Claude Opus 5 at medium effort. NOT the frozen eval suite -- that is configs/guesser_pool_llm_sonnet.json, switched from this pool on cost (docs/log.md, 'The eval guesser is Sonnet, not Opus'). Opus 5 runs adaptive thinking by default; 'effort': 'medium' is what keeps the cost down, rather than disabling thinking, which on Opus 5 can leak <thinking> tags into the visible response (see codenames/guessers/llm.py::LLMGuesser.__init__). Effort is part of the response-cache key (LLMGuesser.cache_model_id). Shares cache/llm_store.db with the Haiku/Sonnet entries; keyed by model, so no collision.
